title: SRD 5.1 importer: action parser
description:
**Prerequisites (apply to all SRD 5.1 importer child issues):**
- Vendored SRD 5.1 PDF must be in place at `packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf` — see that directory's README.md.
- Reference implementation: mirror the structure of `packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseSpells.ts` (parser), `emit.ts` (record builder + manifest description), `index.ts` (pipeline wiring), and the test layout under `packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/`.
- Depends on `loreweaver-0m9.5.9` (section detection + orchestrator) — receive a narrowed slice of the combat-actions section.

---

Add a parser for the standard combat-action entries in SRD 5.1 (kind=action): Attack, Cast a Spell, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Hide, Ready, Search, Use an Object. Each becomes a kind=action record with description text in `data.description`. `key` should be `action:<slug>`.

Split from the original 0m9.5.7 to keep ticket scope shippable in one session.
acceptance_criteria:
- Parser extracts every named standard action from the SRD combat-actions section.
- Records satisfy dnd5e-srd action baseline kindSchema.
- Manifest description includes 'action' in Included record kinds.
- Unit tests cover at least three standard actions.
close_reason: Implemented SRD combat action parser (10 standard actions), section/orchestrator + emitter wiring, manifest kind inclusion, and importer/pipeline/unit tests; verification: npm run check, npm run typecheck, npm run test passed.
